# UTLP HAL Skeleton Example
# Component-level CMakeLists.txt for ESP-IDF
#
# UTLP skeleton with Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) architecture
# Demonstrates protocol-agnostic time sync with phase-aligned PWM
# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/select_source.py - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        # UTLP Application Layer (platform-agnostic pure C)
        "../examples/utlp_skeleton/utlp_skeleton.c"

        # UTLP HAL Implementation (ESP32-C6 specific)
        "../examples/utlp_skeleton/utlp_hal_esp32c6.c"

        # Platform Entry Point (contains app_main)
        "../examples/utlp_skeleton/utlp_main_esp32c6.c"

    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "."
        "../examples/utlp_skeleton"

    REQUIRES
        # FreeRTOS and ESP system
        freertos
        esp_system
        esp_common
        esp_timer

        # Hardware drivers
        driver          # GPIO, MCPWM, ADC

        # Storage
        nvs_flash

        # WiFi and ESP-NOW (required for HAL radio)
        esp_wifi        # WiFi driver for ESP-NOW
        esp_netif       # Network interface (required by esp_wifi)

        # Power management
        esp_pm

        # LED strip encoder (for WS2812B status LED)
        led_strip
)
